extracted.intended_audience: authors and editors looking to hire sensitivity readers or expert consultants for creative-writing projects
extracted.subtask_description: Selecting and commissioning sensitivity/expert readers to ensure authentic, inclusive, and accurate representation in creative-writing works. The page lists individual consultants and the specific lived-experience, cultural, linguistic, and topical expertise they offer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sensitivity Reading — Ensure Authentic, Inclusive Narratives
rubrics_metrics.description: Sensitivity Reading — Ensure Authentic, Inclusive Narratives (service tagline)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Service goal: have experts read for authenticity and inclusivity in narratives. The site offers a roster of sensitivity & expert readers whose lived experience and topical expertise can be matched to an author's project. Authors are invited to request a consult or email if they don't see the area they need.

rubrics_metrics.name: Match readers by lived experience / identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose sensitivity readers whose identities or lived experiences align with the characters or subject matter (e.g., autistic, Black, Native Hawaiian, transmasculine, Muslim, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Profiles explicitly list identities and lived experiences (e.g., 'Autistic', 'Black', 'Native Hawaiian', 'Transmasculinity / transgender men'). Use those details to select readers for authenticity checks rather than relying solely on general demographic labels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mental health and psychiatric experience accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Consult readers with direct experience or expertise on mental health topics (e.g., 'Mental Health (ADD, OCD, Anxiety, Depression, Suicidal Ideation)', 'Schizoaffective Disorder', 'PTSD', 'Bipolar').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select readers who list specific diagnoses or treatment experiences and/or clinical/therapeutic backgrounds to ensure realistic, non-stigmatizing portrayals and to flag harmful or incorrect depictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Neurodivergence and cognitive differences
rubrics_metrics.description: Use readers with neurodivergent experience for representation of autism, ADHD, executive dysfunction, and related topics (e.g., 'Autistic', 'ADHD', 'executive dysfunction', 'ASD Level 1').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Profiles repeatedly call out neurodivergence; authors should consult such readers to avoid stereotypes, ensure sensory/processing authenticity, and advise on character perspective and supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gender identity and sexual orientation representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure portrayals of trans, non-binary, pansexual, asexual, demisexual, aromantic, bisexual, gay, lesbian, and other sexual/gender identities are reviewed by readers with those identities or deep expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many profiles list nuanced sexual/ gender identities (e.g., 'demisexual', 'aromanticism', 'non-binary', 'transmasculine'). Authors should match by specific identity terms where relevant to avoid erasure or mischaracterization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disability, chronic illness, and mobility representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Consult readers with lived experience of disability, chronic illness, and mobility aid use (e.g., 'Wheelchair/Ambulatory Wheelchair Use', 'Chronic illness', 'Spinal Muscular Atrophy', 'Ulcerative Colitis / IBD').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Profiles include specifics about surgeries, adaptive tech, therapy, and accessibility. Use such consultants to check physical details, daily life, assistive devices, medical accuracy, and ableist language/assumptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trauma, sexual assault, and reproductive experiences
rubrics_metrics.description: Use readers with direct experience or expertise for topics such as sexual assault, miscarriage, difficult pregnancies, high-risk pregnancy, birth trauma, and grief.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Several consultants list 'Sexual assault', 'Miscarriage', 'Difficult Pregnancies & Miscarriage', 'High-risk pregnancy (bedrest, hyperemesis gravidarum, placenta previa)'. They can advise on trauma-informed depiction, triggers, and realistic emotional/medical detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Race, racism, microaggressions, and decolonial perspectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Consult readers with racialized or Indigenous backgrounds and/or scholarship in race to evaluate portrayals of race, racism, colorism, microaggressions, colonialism, and decolonization themes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Profiles include 'Black', 'Latinx', 'Native Hawaiian', 'Ojibwe', 'Abenaki and Mohawk', 'African-American culture and issues', and specialists in critical race theory and decolonization. Use them to spot stereotypes, historical erasures, and power dynamics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Culture, diaspora, and immigrant experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Match readers knowledgeable about specific cultures, diasporas, and immigrant/minority experiences (e.g., 'Indian culture', 'Indian diaspora', 'Arab Diaspora', 'Palestinian culture', '2nd generation immigrants').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultants list region- and culture-specific lived experience; they can advise on family dynamics, food, rituals, language use, intergenerational trauma, casteism, and cultural nuance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Religion and faith backgrounds
rubrics_metrics.description: Use readers with experience of particular religious traditions (e.g., 'Reform and Reconstructionist Judaism', 'Hinduism', 'Muslim', 'Christianity', 'Catholicism', 'Mormonism', 'Secular Buddhism') for faith-based representation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Faith influences practices, language, belief, and conflict; select consultants who state familiarity with the denomination, conversion/deconstruction experiences, or faith-specific trauma.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language, dialect, and translation accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure language use and code-switching are reviewed (e.g., 'Spanish language (working fluency, translation)', 'Standard and regional Spanish', 'Standard and regional French', 'Portuguese', 'English/Spanish Code-switching', 'Jamaican Patois, Patois, AAVE, Caribbean Dialects').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Profiles note translation checks and dialect competence. Use these readers for authenticity in dialogue, idioms, code-switching, and to avoid caricature or mistranslation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography and regional specificity
rubrics_metrics.description: Consult readers familiar with the local/regional context of settings (e.g., 'Living in the American South', 'Growing up in Hawaii', 'San Francisco Bay area', 'Vancouver, Canada', 'Spain and the Netherlands').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regional readers can advise on local colloquialisms, social dynamics, institutions, and place-based details that ground a story in authenticity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Family structures, parenting, and care systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Enlist readers experienced with nontraditional family structures and child-related systems (e.g., 'Child of a same-sex couple', 'Fostering and adopting', 'Parenting neurodivergent children', 'Homeschooling').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These consultants can check plausibility of family dynamics, institutional interactions (CPS, family court), educational choices, and caregiver stress/decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional, institutional, and community contexts
rubrics_metrics.description: Match readers with relevant occupational/community knowledge (e.g., 'Military experience', 'Performing Arts (Music)', 'Film/Television Production', 'TTRPGs', 'Gaming community', 'Search for precursors', 'Clean energy', 'Data mining').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Experts with domain knowledge can validate procedural accuracy, jargon use, subculture norms, and workplace/institutional realities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disordered eating, body image, and fat representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Use readers with lived experience/expertise in eating disorders, body image, and fatphobia/fat positivity to evaluate portrayals (e.g., 'Eating Disorder Partial Hospitalization', 'Body positivity', 'Fatphobia').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: They can flag harmful tropes, advise on recovery/relapse realism, and suggest ethical/trauma-informed framing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation checks and multilingual authenticity as a service criterion
rubrics_metrics.description: Offer translation checks and language validation as a specific deliverable (e.g., 'Translation checks: Spanish, French, German, and Brazilian Portuguese'; 'Minor Spanish translations/slang use').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should request explicit translation/language-validation services when text contains foreign-language phrasing, code-switching, or culturally-specific terms to avoid errors and appropriation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trauma-informed therapeutic and clinical process accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Consult readers who can verify therapy and clinical depictions (e.g., 'CBT therapy, DBT therapy, group therapy, marriage counseling, EMDR', 'Inpatient and outpatient mental health treatment').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These consultants can ensure therapeutic modalities, institutional settings, and clinician-client interactions are portrayed accurately and sensitively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specialty-topic consults (e.g., immigration, legal/foster care, school systems)
rubrics_metrics.description: Hire expert consultants for narrow but high-impact topics such as 'Foster care & CPS intervention', 'Family court', 'Special needs education (ABA)', 'Military life', 'Appalachian Environmental Justice'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The roster includes domain specialists; authors should request consults for procedural/legal/institutional accuracy that affects plot or character outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of multiple overlapping identities / intersectional review
rubrics_metrics.description: Seek readers who can account for intersectionality (race × gender × disability × religion etc.) rather than treating identities in isolation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Profiles often combine multiple identity markers (e.g., 'Black Native/Afro-Indigenous Experiences', 'Queer BIPOC Experiences', 'Mixed-race/multiethnic'). Intersectional readers can highlight compounded experiences and avoid single-axis assumptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial process and consult logistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical service criteria: authors can 'Request a Consult', there are prices and service types (sensitivity reading, developmental editing, beta reading, proofreading), and a 'FREE Consultation' option to determine the right service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should use the consult to scope deliverables (line-level changes vs. content notes), confirm turnaround, and check that the chosen reader's expertise matches the project's needs. The site invites contact if an area of expertise isn't listed.
